name: SLX clamp-mounted front derailleur
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed average 158 g for FD-M661, 3×9-speed, down swing, 34.9 mm clamp band, without S/M reducer adapters. The weight heading explicitly selects L-size band type; the mount rows distinguish the unadapted 34.9 mm band from 28.6/31.8 mm reducer configurations. Other mount variants do not inherit this weight. This is the nine-speed model, distinct from FD-M661-10.
